    #   - "Rollback"         = removing the published content from the

    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    readback_volume = 10     # uL used by the consumer for verification

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        await lh.aspirate(source_plate["A1"], vols=[publish_volume])

            await lh.dispense(destination_plate["A1"], vols=[readback_volume])
            print("Consumer readback completed: content matches expectation.")

            print(f"Consumer readback indicates a mismatch/failure: {e}")

        # Step 3: Rollback decision based on readback result
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

                # Restore the content to the source (previous state)
